issues.detail: Most requirements and triggers come from a superseded 2021 PDF ('Validation Checklist Final 2021 A.pdf' on services.swale.gov.uk), not the current 2024 joint list behind the workbook link. Triggers quote the old numbering and wording, e.g. 'B9.) Transport Statement Annex 2 in the Glossary section of the February 2019 NPPF...' and 'Section 15 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2019)'. The current list renumbered and re-scoped the items (A1-A15, B1-B26).
issues.evidence: Current list: 'Part A and B requirements apply equally to Maidstone and Swale borough councils, unless stated otherwise' (Published 15 November 2024)

issues.detail: The List date 2026-10-01 rests on 'Published October 2026', which does not appear on the council page. The Validation Checklist and Local requirements pages both say 'Published 15 November 2024'; the combined PDF is from June 2024.

issues.claude_response: Kept. I re-checked the live Swale validation checklist pages today: both say "Published 15 November 2024", not October 2026. Grok is wrong here.

issues.detail: Grokbot applies several Maidstone-only requirements to Swale. Affordable Housing Statement (A9, Maidstone only: 10+ dwellings or 0.5 ha) is under Swale 'Full planning'. 'CIL Additional Information / Form' (A11, Maidstone only; Swale is not a CIL charging authority) is listed with trigger 'All planning applications that are CIL liable'. Tab items quote Maidstone's CIL charging schedule and Public Art thresholds (B12, Maidstone only), and the Ventilation row's trigger is actually the Maidstone public-art threshold ('net increase of 50 dwellings or more ... 2,000m²').
issues.evidence: Current list A9/A11/A12 and B12-B14, B16-B17, B19-B23 marked 'Maidstone only'

issues.detail: These current requirements that apply to Swale were not captured in app_type_rows: Ecological/Protected Species Survey (A6: likely effect on protected species, or SSSI incl. 200m buffer, SPA or SAC); Biodiversity Net Gain additional information (A13: where a Gain Plan is required or an exemption claimed, excluding householder; Swale minimum 10%); Site levels and sections at 1:50/1:100 (A14: changes in land level or sloping sites); Scale bar (A2: all applications); Noise Impact Assessment (B3: noisy development, or noise-sensitive uses near roads, rail or commercial noise); Retail and town centre impact assessment incl. sequential test (B6, Swale: over 500 sqm outside the town centre); Minerals assessment (B11: Minerals Safeguarding Area); Viability appraisal (B15: viability used to justify a policy departure); Drawings for off-site highway works (B18); Water efficiency at 110 litres/person/day (B24: all new dwellings); Archaeological information (B25: areas of archaeological importance); Coastal erosion vulnerability assessment (B26, Swale only: Erosion Zones 1 and 2 on the Proposals Map).
issues.evidence: Combined 2024 list Part A A2, A6, A13, A14; Part B B3, B6, B11, B15, B18, B24, B25, B26

issues.detail: Householder, Outline, Reserved matters and most other app types are marked '(none) - national requirements only'. But Part A is 'Required for all applications' where triggered, so the Heritage statement (A4), FRA (A5), Ecology (A6), Tree survey (A7), Shadow HRA (A8), Street scene (A3) and Site levels (A14) all apply to householder and outline schemes when triggered. BNG (A13) explicitly excludes householder only. Every substantive requirement was put under 'Full planning' with an 'INFERRED' note; Heritage Statement alone was placed under Listed building consent.
issues.evidence: PDF heading 'Part A: Required for all applications'; A13 '(excluding householder applications)'

issues.detail: Several requirement names are paired with text from other items. 'Ventilation / Extraction details' carries the public-art thresholds; the real trigger (B10) is hot-food takeaways, pubs/bars, restaurants, launderettes and uses with substantial extraction. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' carries tree AMS text ('an Arboricultural Method Statement (AMS) with tree protection details must also be provided'). 'Self-build / custom build information' carries CIL exemption text; the real trigger (A15) is applications made under s.1(A1) of the Self-build and Custom Housebuilding Act 2015. 'Planning Obligations / S106' and 'Energy / Sustainability Statement' both end in 'Applications that will require a Renewable Energy Assessment are listed below: B5'. 'Fire Statement' and 'Design and Access Statement' (both national, not local) carry Part A/B heading text.
issues.evidence: Current B10 Ventilation and extraction; A15 Self-build proforma; B5 'New development involving erection or conversion of a building ... Swale: energy assessment under Policy DM19'

issues.detail: Several triggers are outdated or too vague to apply. Transport Assessment/Statement quotes NPPF glossary text instead of the thresholds (TA: 40+ dwellings or 2,500 sqm+; TS: 10-39 dwellings, 1,000-2,499 sqm or 0.25 ha+). The HRA trigger is a generic NPPG quote instead of A8 (net increase in overnight population served by a wastewater system in the River Stour catchment, incl. non-mains drainage). 'Nutrient Neutrality statement' is just the fragment 'to achieve nutrient neutrality as part of their application.' Structural Survey uses the 2021 wording ('substantial demolition, reconstruction or alteration'); current B7 covers countryside conversions relying on structural soundness and listed-building works. FRA omits the critical drainage area and SFRA increased-risk triggers. Tree survey omits tree removal/pruning and the 30m ancient woodland / veteran tree trigger.
issues.evidence: Current B8/B9 thresholds; A8 'Shadow' HRA; A5 FRA; A7 tree survey

issues.detail: The tab_items are almost all process text or fragments rather than requirements: 'When submitting plans to MKPS our preferred size is A1', file size/type rules ('individual files should not be larger than 10MB ... Plans: .pdf'), 'refrain from submitting plans in booklet forms', the Maidstone CIL charging schedule note with a broken URL fragment ('ure%20Levy%20Charging%20Schedule.pdf Note:'), and the public art guidance URL fragment ('...Public-Art-GuidanceNovember-2017.pdf 23'). The A5/Ecology item is a run-together table fragment.

Street scene elevations appear three times: as 'Street scene elevations', as 'Floor plans / Elevations' (same street-scene trigger) and inside the DAS trigger. The north point / scale bar drawing rule is repeated in three tab items. 'Nutrient Neutrality statement' and 'Habitats Regulations Assessment / SPA mitigation' both describe the single current A8 Shadow HRA requirement.
issues.evidence: app_type_rows Full planning; tab_items 'Drawing / document standards'

issues.detail: The 'Planning page' URL (local-requirements-v2/site-specific-flood-risk-assessment-fra) and the other 'local-requirements-v2' pages in docs_read did not load: the site returned a client error. The live requirements are at /validation-checklist/local-requirements.

summary: The workbook link is the live joint Maidstone and Swale checklist page (published 15 November 2024, not October 2026). However, Grokbot's extraction relies mainly on a superseded 2021 PDF, applies Maidstone-only items (affordable housing, CIL, public art) to Swale, mismatches several requirement/trigger pairs, and misses many current Swale requirements, including BNG, ecology, noise, retail impact, minerals, water efficiency, archaeology and coastal erosion.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
